title: Effectiveness of P02 Digital Hearing Aids
brief_summary: To test the effectiveness of body-worn, digital hearing aids, model 02 which is developed by the National Electronics and Computer Technology Center, Thailand.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* older than 60 years
* bilateral sensorineural hearing loss
* PTA (0.5-2 KHz) of better ear \> 40 DB but \<75 dB
* no deformity of pinna and ear canal
* new or unexperienced hearing aids user
* can communicate with Thai or local language

Exclusion Criteria:

* speech discrimination \<40%
* suspected of retrocochlear lesion
